answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. By the quartz of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, reset on any identity-link attempt, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Every claim climbs the comet of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the vertex re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
